Hello ISBA members, and welcome to the third issue of the ISBA Bulletin for 2026!

As usual, I will keep this very brief: there is plenty of news and information waiting for you in this issue. Be sure not to miss the latest updates from ISBA officers, and join us in celebrating this year’s award winners and newly elected ISBA Fellows.
Also, take a close look at the report from the BayesAI section, the reports from some of the wonderful events that took place this summer, and the many exciting events coming up in the next few months.

As always, many thanks to everyone who contributed to this issue.
ISBA community, enjoy!
:::
